export default function Privacy(){return

Accounts and authentication

The API stores account email, display name, a password hash, role, MFA state and TOTP enrollment information, including secrets needed for verification. Refresh tokens are stored as hashes. The web portal stores access and refresh tokens in browser local storage. The admin session holds tokens in its server-side circuit.

Files and activity

Cloud processing sends file contents to the backend for scanning, compression or decompression. Stored records include filenames, sizes, checksums, codec, status, ownership and artifact locations. Sharing stores recipient email, code hashes, expiration and download counters. Audit records contain account identifiers, actions, resources, results and timestamps.

Email and devices

Configured email providers process delivery addresses and message contents for enrollment or file email. Mobile authenticator accounts and TOTP secrets use device secure storage. Desktop settings and history are stored locally; cloud workflows transmit data to the configured API.

Unresolved operator decisions

No verified automatic retention schedule or self-service account deletion flow is provided. Share-code expiry does not delete stored files. Hosting access logs, IP metadata, backups, provider retention, data location, deletion requests and an operator contact must be documented before production approval.

No compliance certification, end-to-end encryption or guaranteed deletion period is asserted here.

}

export default function Security(){return

File processing

Cloud processing integrates ClamAV and YARA checks. Required scanner failures block processing; architecture does not establish that a scanner is currently operational. View current readiness.

Compression uses reconstruction and SHA-256 integrity checks. These checks are not encryption and do not guarantee that a file is harmless.

Sharing and storage

Share codes are restricted to a recipient account, expiration and download count. The backend processes file contents and stores artifacts. End-to-end encryption, zero-knowledge storage and managed envelope encryption are not verified capabilities.

Identity and assurance

The current API uses password authentication, access and refresh tokens, and TOTP. Enterprise SSO, passkeys and external security certification are not established by this implementation.

Read data-processing information and unresolved privacy requirements
